Too many brews to hold in your hands?! Well, how 'bout you make a bag for it? A Brew Bag! I'll show ya how to make one since I'm feeling nice, though I gotta warn ya, the bag can only hold $(bold)throwable brews$()!
Press Open Brew Bag key (Default: H) to open bag's inventory, Open Brew Circle key (Default: J) to throw a brew from it.
To truly start brewing, you must add a $(item)Henbane Flower$() into the boiling cauldron! Then, when it starts emitting purple sparks, we can truly begin nyehahahaha!

How do you get a Henbane Flower you asked? You grow them, that's how! Now be a good would-be witch, make, or steal, a boline and start foraging some grass or fern for the seeds, along with other wonderful plants!

The brewing process goes as follows,$(br2)$()$(l)Capacity -> Catalyst -> Augmentation -> Completion!$()$(br2)Remember these steps brat! Mix them up and your brew will be ruined! Now you might be asking, Granny, what do these words mean? Well shut ya yap and I'll tell ya!

Once the Capacity, Catalyst and Augmentation are added in, and your brew isn't bellowing black smokes, your brew is ready for the Completion process! You must right click the Cauldron with the Cauldron Ladle to begin so don't go bottling the brew yet!

Make sure your Soul Candlesticks can transfer the required amount of energy, which you can see by looking at the Cauldron while crouching, before starting! The Cauldron will emit Effect Particles once the process is completed, which is when you can start bottling your brew!

Make sure you wear your proper Witch attire when bottling! Everyone knows that a Witch's Hat and Robes gives a chance of extra brews! Also, here's a little ol' secret from Ol' Granny! Apples can be quite... receptive to taking in brews. Remember Snow White? Hehehehahaha!

Also, don't forget that your cauldron must to full of the brew to use your $(bold)taglock kit$(), or a $(bold)waystone$() on it! If ya don't know what either those things are, too bad! Ol'Granny's talking about brewing! Get another Granny to show the other paths of the old ways! Hahahahaha!

A Brew can hold more effects and augmentation than regular old potions, but it needs enough capacity to hold them! Put more ingredients than the brew's capacity and you'll be left with a hot mess! Usually, a simple brew can hold a single ingredient! But there are ways to increase the brew's capacity!

I must make it clear! These ingredients must be put into order to increase the brew's capacity, so no shortcutting by just throwing the last ingredient in! Also, remember that the first thing you needed to put in the Cauldron is a $(item)Henbane Flower$() to begin brewing!

$(bold)Capacity Order$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Henbane Flower$() - +1 $(li)$(item)Nether Wart$() - +2 $(li)$(item)Snap Fungus$() - +2 $(li)$(item)Awakened Emerald$() - +2 $(li)$(item)Concentrated Emerald$() - +2 $(li)$(item)Withered Manuscript$() - +4 $(li)$(item)Ruby of Souls$() - +6
Here are the catalysts to give your brew an effect! As you may have noticed, some of these effects are unfamiliar and most of those effects are exclusive to good ol' witch brewing!

But don't worry! Ol' Granny will explain what some of them do since I'm feeling nice today! If the catalyst is a spawn egg, it means you gotta boil whatever spawns from that egg in your cauldron! Oh, and some of these effects take up more than 1 capacity, so that's another thing to look out for when brewing! Hehahaha!

c.text: Ol' Granny loves to throw these brews at those whippersnappers when they keep messing her garden, even if they were moving corpses! Though it appears some cretins have too long of a lifespan, or some other oddities, for the brew to have affect, like those weird cyclops of the ocean!
Those arrows sure are annoying! Here! Now those arrows will annoy you instead! Hahahaha!
Fly my pretties! Fly and eat the faces of my foes!
Buzzing bumbles, flying rumbles, sting my foe, honey my toes!
Teleports the affected to a random location! The higher the level, the more further they can teleport to!
Be better at brewing by brewing a brew that makes you brew better!
Changes the Brew's colors into whatever dyes you throw in! Careful though! The color will change if you add another Catalyst or dye!
With Axe of Stone, I cast my brew! I see a tree and it's wood I hew!
Ever wish to feast on the last breath of your kills? Well now you can! Tasty too!
See those blocks? Not anymore (Unless its Obsidian)! I see your armor, and I think it could be a little more damaged! Hahahaha!
A Curse upon you! No healing for you! I just rhymed you with you! What ya gonna do?
Why block a projectile when you can have said projectile shoot back at the shooter!
Too much water! With this brew, there will be no water!
Teaches those Enderman to not disappear when getting slashed or splashed on!
You know the old tale of cats jumping and clawing at the ceiling when surprised? Well, what if they end up jumping to whole new location instead, and the surprise is a knife to the face?
The glare of evil attracts all kinds of folks, perfect for having a party!
See that house over there? Ta-da! Now it's got a hole on it!
Careful hurting creatures with this effect ya guttersnipe! Last I've heard, they may have an EXPLOSIVE temper! Hahahaha!
What do you mean you're not feeling it? Get to breeding! Granny needs some new pair of Leather Boots!
Don't get too close to me! I'm too hot for ya!
Catch me if you can if you can handle my hot boots!
The fires stings a lot more than usual! Almost like you're made of grass!
Talk to these hands and you'll be burning!
Rips the skin, feathers and wool from Animals! Leaves the meat and flesh behind, though don't think they'll be fine! Hahaha!
Makes even the sturdiest of fools bend to the winds!
Too little water! With this brew, there will be water!
Bah! Who needs Enchantments when you have brews! Ol'Granny needs some extra diamonds, and she's all out of Lapis!
Sometimes Ol' Granny wants to skate in their Swamp on their hag-made frozen pond!
Hey kiddies! Wanna BE a Snowman? Hehehahaha!
Why just jump off the ground when you can also jump off the air as well?
Don't get too close to me! I'm too cold for ya!
While not fully gold, they sure do drop them dead!
Hey, don't be shy! These hands aren't gonna punch themselves! Get over here!
Bringing the green dye to the sandy beaches of my home!
Those vines from those lushes caves can be pretty when hanging in my own cave! Unfortunately, these vines don't come glowing!
For when my herbs aren't growing fast enough! Granny's not gonna Bone Meal each and everyone of ya!
What's a Witch that don't surround themselves with trees? The Catalyst can be any Sapling!
A bucket of water breaks the seeds! With this brew, the ground retains its treats!
Makes certain Stones and Stone Bricks infested with those adorable Silverfishes!
Boil a Silverfish in your cauldron if you can't get any infested stone around!
This effect is great for hunting down those delicious insects, especially the big ones!
Better light those matches! Those leaves aren't so easy to break by hand!
Hitting a ruffian with your fist or stick will heal you a tiny percent of their max health.
Granny needs to bring the Lush out of the caves sometimes! Also some Mossy Cobblestones and Bricks!
Grab a night light kiddies! You're gonna need it!
Forgot to bring my Strider with me. Looks like I gotta part the lava lakes to go to places!
Left my spinning blade at home, now how am I gonna cross this sea? Oh, good thing I got me brews with me!
Bask in the sunlight my darlings! Take a good look at that ball of fire! I'm sure you won't get blinded!
Seems like you've been eating a lot of Granny's cookies! Here, have some more!
Feel like everyone's looking at ya weirdly? Good thing it doesn't actually hurt ya! Or can it? Hehahaha!
Get those dang floating Leaves out of my property!
Stone to Cobble to Gravel to Sand! Get me some coal and make me a glass!
Removes all non harmful effects from those dang kids!
Removes all harmful effects from those dang kids!
Here's a secret from Ol' Granny! Sometimes I feel younger after smacking a brat with my old sandal!
Wake up sleepy heads! Granny can't carry all these bags herself!
Get those brats to hit harder when you're near them!
Ever wonder where those stories of witches making people stew comes from?! Hehehahaha!
What? Don't like my perfume after trying to get to know Ol' Granny?!
My fists feels harder, only because your face is softer!
Got the idea from eating those Echoey Shards! Makes the effects stick even after drinking some Milk, and apparently death? Must be useful to those darn immortal types, like that blue compass thing!
My arms are too old to be shearing those Sheeps! My brews will do it for Ol' Granny!
It seems being near Ol'Granny makes those hits a bit less painful!
I heard you whippersnappers love getting slime all over yourselves! Why you'll surely love Ol'Granny's bottle then!
Sometimes Ol' Granny wants her yard to be clear of corpses, especially if they walk!
When Granny feels like she wants to play in the snow!
Wanna BE a snow man?! Well you gotta boil one first!
It's either wrath from the clouds or love from the very lightning itself. Either way, you're getting a new hairstyle!
Oh no, I ain't prude enough to rip your clothes off! Just your armor! I could tear off most of them if my brew is higher level *wink*.
Hey kiddies! You want to BE a Skeleton? Or Zombie? Or Phantom? Or...
Granny wants to make Sweet Berry Pie, but my poor legs are too tired to go to the Taiga. Meh, just make my own Berry Bushes then!
No one expects an Ol' Granny like me to skedaddle quickly in water!
Better not gang up on someone with this effect, else you'll get sliced up as they punch someone's face!
You're surrounded brat! You should stop walking unless you get a face full of thorns! Hahahaha!
Gathers all kinds of entity, including Items, to the location where the brew was landed or drunk!
Careful where you walk kids! You might trip and be thrown off to a random direction! If the levels higher, you'll be tripping constantly!
My hands are made of Spiders! Hahahaha!
Get in touch with the void, brat! Make sure you don't get touched by anything else!
Those spiders sure work fast! Though they seemed to only make webs when the brew hits a creature instead of on solid land...
Let the hate flow through you!

pages.text: Our Cauldrons aren't just for making brews! Sometimes you can make stew or some unguents to cover your body with for some effects!

To start making non-brews, instead of throwing a Henbane Flower, you throw in the good ol' Nightshade! Like Henbane, you get the seeds from breaking grass and ferns with the $(l:brewing/brewing_steps#boline)boline$(), and grow them on farmland!
This lotion will strengthened up your skin and bones when applied, making you take less damage from incoming attacks!
I swear that some of the other grannies in the coven aren't actually as old as they look! Surely they're using this cream to make their skin more wrinkly!
HAHAHAHAHA! Good ol' Flying Ointment! Makes you feel like you're actually flying and pumps you up! Works well with a broom hahaha!
Told ya you can stew outta this!
Some witches requires a more fancy get-up to make candles out of their cauldron, but out here, we just use a piece of string and get somehow get perfectly shaped wax cylinders out of it!

Greetings worm! If you're reading this, you must be either one lucky little guttersnipe, or a true seeker of knowledge! I have many names, but you can call me Granny, or Ms. Toefungus if you're feeling polite, ehehehehe! So you want to be a master of the art of brewing, eh? Well don't rely on those Brewing Stands then! A true Witch uses their Cauldrons to make their artistry!
But not just any Cauldron will do! You need a true Witch's Cauldron! Place it on a fireplace, or campfire or those magma blocks or whatever and fill it with water!
The Cauldron also needs the power of the spirit world to properly brew, so it must have some Soul Candlesticks that can absorb the energies of the dead around.
You also need a Cauldron Ladle in order to brew properly! When brewing, you would need to right-click the Cauldron with the ladle to begin the Completion stage!
If your brew has failed or you're unsatisfied with it, shift-right click the Cauldron with a magic Wand or Staff will clear all of its content!
There are ways to improve your brewing station to use less energy! First, make sure you're brewing in a Swamp! It's a nice and moist land filled with wonderful bugs!

A Witch's Pole helps reduce the amount of energy needed to make a brew when placed within 8 blocks of a Witch's Cauldron. Only up to 3 Poles will give the effect. If you're using a Taglock Kit or a Waystone on your cauldron, each of them will also increases how the cauldron's reach! Why, with 3 of them, you can have the brew land anywhere! So long as that where is in the same dimension of course.
Wonder why we sometimes have black cats around us? Aside from having company, having a black cat around a Witch's Cauldron adds a 25%% chance of granting an extra brew!
